methodology.purpose: Review one existing complete wealth-feedback policy for a defensive role in an expert pool, without requiring standalone final-portfolio qualification or claiming complementary returns in advance.
methodology.observation_construction: Use the preserved ten-year base net shadow account, its actual closing high-water mark, the exact saved monthly baseline and the unchanged original protected_target law. Derive a separately versioned daily recommendation artifact, including its actual initial anchor. Check all four original request/state/account records; do not run any old account, preparation or evaluation entry point.
methodology.initial_availability: The first real known recommendation is the original shadow initial-capital decision on 2016-10-05. No 2016-09-30 recommendation or pre-shadow return is invented. A future meta study must explicitly preserve its 2016-10-06 formal start and unscored maturity behavior.
methodology.capital_and_execution: Native shadow wealth, daily feedback, five-point band and fixed-fee scale are not the main account. A meta account cannot inherit its drawdown floor, wealth path or net-return guarantee.
methodology.deduplication: The plain protected source is the one reviewed representative. Its dollar-half variant and other wealth-floor variants are not additional independent mechanisms in this admission.
methodology.selection_bias: The source has exposed historical results. Selecting a defensive risk role from the existing library is not independent out-of-sample or forward validation.
methodology.policy_registration_and_expert_admission: Retain the actual 2026-10-11 policy registration separately from the present expert admission and counterfactual 2016 historical availability.
